name: No Fate! ~Only the Power of Will~
original_name: のーふぇいと！～only the power of will～
source:
I was just an average high school boy... Just boring, mediocre and normal... But one day, a girl falls down from the sky. 

According to her, she came from the world beyond the inner space... My extraordinary life is about to begin with the arrival of an extraordinary girl...

[Edited from Himeyashop]
translation:
我原本只是个普通的高中男生…无趣、平庸而平凡…可有一天，一个女孩从天而降。

据她所说，她来自内宇宙彼端的世界…随着这名非同寻常的女孩到来，我非同寻常的生活也即将开始…

[编辑自Himeyashop]
